content.comment_body: Could someone please assist me? I enabled web access using [product_name]. I can access the device within my WiFi network using the IP 192.168.100.250:8080. I believe I just need to forward port 8080 on my router, but I'm not experienced with this and think I might have made a mistake. See the screenshot attached. When I forward the port to another device, such as my music system, it works. I hope someone can help me. Thank you in advance.

Thanks for providing some details. Are you trying to access the [product_name] from outside your home network, or is there another reason for using the port number? Also, can you clarify what exactly you want to access—are you referring to the web server?

I want to access the [product_name] from outside my home network. I've created a website on the micro-SD card in the device, which I can access within my home network through the web server. According to forum advice, I should forward port 8080 to the local IP of the [product_name] (192.168.100.250). Then I should be able to connect by entering http://[my external IP]:8080, but it's not working.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to set up remote access to the web interface of their [product_name] device via port forwarding, but hasn't been successful outside their local network. The thread revolves around network configuration issues and highlights the need for clearer instructions for users unfamiliar with network setups.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that forwarding a port on their router to the [product_name] device will allow remote web access, as outlined in official documentation and forum advice.
